pitchFamily="34" charset="-120"/></a:rPr><a:t>RSA (1977): الأمان مبني على صعوبة تحليل الأعداد إلى عوامل أولية. توليد المفتاح: اختر أعداداً أولية p,q؛ n=pq؛ φ(n)=(p−1)(q−1)؛ e أولي مع φ(n)؛ d=e⁻¹ mod φ(n). التشفير: C = Mᵉ mod n. الفك: M = Cᵈ mod n. الحد الأدنى الموصى به 2048 بت (3072 بت لما بعد 2030).</a:t></a:r><a:endParaRPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"/></a:p><a:p><a:pPr rtl="1"  algn="r" marL="342900" indent="-342900"><a:spcAft><a:spcPts val="400"/></a:spcAft><a:buSzPct val="100000"/><a:buChar char="&#x2022;"/></a:pPr><a:r><a:rPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"><a:solidFill><a:srgbClr val="2C3E50"/></a:solidFill><a:latin typeface="Arial" pitchFamily="34" charset="0"/><a:ea typeface="Arial" pitchFamily="34" charset="-122"/><a:cs typeface="Arial" pitchFamily="34" charset="-120"/></a:rPr><a:t>ECDH: نقاط على المنحنى E: y²=x³+ax+b على الحقل المنتهي F_p. تبادل المفاتيح: السر المشترك = k_A · k_B · G. توفر NIST P-256 أمان ~128 بت بمفاتيح 256 بت مقارنة بـ 3072 بت في RSA.</a:t></a:r><a:endParaRPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"/></a:p><a:p><a:pPr rtl="1"  algn="r" marL="342900" indent="-342900"><a:spcAft><a:spcPts val="400"/></a:spcAft><a:buSzPct val="100000"/><a:buChar char="&#x2022;"/></a:pPr><a:r><a:rPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"><a:solidFill><a:srgbClr val="2C3E50"/></a:solidFill><a:latin typeface="Arial" pitchFamily="34" charset="0"/><a:ea typeface="Arial" pitchFamily="34" charset="-122"/><a:cs typeface="Arial" pitchFamily="34" charset="-120"/></a:rPr><a:t>AES: شيفرة كتلية متماثلة 128/192/256 بت. 10/12/14 جولة. عمليات SubBytes وShiftRows وMixColumns وAddRoundKey. يوفر AES-256-GCM تشفيراً موثقاً (AEAD).</a:t></a:r><a:endParaRPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"/></a:p><a:p><a:pPr rtl="1"  algn="r" marL="342900" indent="-342900"><a:spcAft><a:spcPts val="400"/></a:spcAft><a:buSzPct val="100000"/><a:buChar char="&#x2022;"/></a:pPr><a:r><a:rPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" pitchFamily="34" charset="-120"/></a:rPr><a:t>SHA-3 (Keccak): بنية إسفنجية بمعدل r وسعة c. أطوال الإخراج 224/256/384/512 بت. مقاومة الصورة الأولية: 2^n، مقاومة التصادم: 2^(n/2). مختلف هيكلياً عن SHA-2.</a:t></a:r><a:endParaRPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"/></a:p><a:p><a:pPr rtl="1"  algn="r" marL="342900" indent="-342900"><a:spcAft><a:spcPts val="400"/></a:spcAft><a:buSzPct charset="0"/><a:ea typeface="Arial" pitchFamily="34" charset="-122"/><a:cs typeface="Arial" pitchFamily="34" charset="-120"/></a:rPr><a:t>إثبات عدم المعرفة (ZKP): يُقنع المُثبت المُتحقق بصحة عبارة دون الكشف عن السبب. ثلاث خصائص: اكتمال، سلامة، عدم معرفة. zk-SNARKs: تُستخدم في Zcash ودرجات إيثيريوم.</a:t></a:r><a:endParaRPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"/></a:p><a:p><a:pPr rtl="1"  algn="r" pitchFamily="34" charset="-120"/></a:rPr><a:t>تشفير ما بعد الكم (NIST): CRYSTALS-Kyber (تغليف مفتاح، شبكي)، CRYSTALS-Dilithium (توقيعات، شبكي)، SPHINCS+ (توقيعات، قائم على التجزئة). خوارزمية شور تكسر val="2C3E50"/></a:solidFill><a:latin typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="0"/><a:ea typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-122"/><a:cs typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-120"/></a:rPr><a:t>Zeroth Law: If A is in thermal equilibrium with B, and B with C, then A is in equilibrium with C. Defines temperature as a transitive property.</a:t></a:r><a:endParaRPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"/></a:p><a:p><a:pPr marL="342900" indent="-342900"><a:spcAft><a:spcPts val="400"/></a:spcAft><a:buSzPct val="100000"/><a:buChar char="&#x2022;"/></a:pPr><a:r><a:rPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"><a:solidFill><a:srgbClr val="2C3E50"/></a:solidFill><a:latin typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="0"/><a:ea typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-122"/><a:cs typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-120"/></a:rPr><a:t>First Law: ΔU = Q − W  (energy conservation). For reversible process: dU = TdS − PdV. For an ideal gas: ΔU = nCᵥΔT.</a:t></a:r><a:endParaRPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"/></a:p><a:p><a:pPr marL="342900" indent="-342900"><a:spcAft><a:spcPts val="400"/></a:spcAft><a:buSzPct val="100000"/><a:buChar char="&#x2022;"/></a:pPr><a:r><a:rPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"><a:solidFill><a:srgbClr val="2C3E50"/></a:solidFill><a:latin typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="0"/><a:ea typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-122"/><a:cs typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-120"/></a:rPr><a:t>Second Law: Entropy of an isolated system never decreases: ΔS ≥ 0. Clausius statement: Heat cannot spontaneously flow from cold to hot. Kelvin–Planck: No engine converts heat entirely to work.</a:t></a:r><a:endParaRPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"/></a:p><a:p><a:pPr marL="342900" indent="-342900"><a:spcAft><a:spcPts val="400"/></a:spcAft><a:buSzPct val="100000"/><a:buChar char="&#x2022;"/></a:pPr><a:r><a:rPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"><a:solidFill><a:srgbClr val="2C3E50"/></a:solidFill><a:latin typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="0"/><a:ea typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-122"/><a:cs typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-120"/></a:rPr><a:t>Third Law: As T → 0 K, entropy approaches a constant minimum (S → 0 for a perfect crystal). Implies impossibility of reaching absolute zero.</a:t></a:r><a:endParaRPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"/></a:p><a:p><a:pPr marL="342900" indent="-342900"><a:spcAft><a:spcPts val="400"/></a:spcAft><a:buSzPct val="100000"/><a:buChar char="&#x2022;"/></a:pPr><a:r><a:rPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"><a:solidFill><a:srgbClr val="2C3E50"/></a:solidFill><a:latin typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="0"/><a:ea typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-122"/><a:cs typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-120"/></a:rPr><a:t>Carnot Efficiency: η_Carnot = 1 − T_cold/T_hot. This is the theoretical maximum for any heat engine operating between two reservoirs.</a:t></a:r><a:endParaRPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"/></a:p><a:p><a:pPr marL="342900" indent="-342900"><a:spcAft><a:spcPts val="400"/></a:spcAft><a:buSzPct val="100000"/><a:buChar char="&#x2022;"/></a:pPr><a:r><a:rPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"><a:solidFill><a:srgbClr val="2C3E50"/></a:solidFill><a:latin typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="0"/><a:ea typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-122"/><a:cs typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-120"/></a:rPr><a:t>Gibbs Free Energy: G = H − TS. Spontaneous process ⟹ ΔG &lt; 0 at constant T and P. At equilibrium: ΔG = 0.</a:t></a:r><a:endParaRPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"/></a:p><a:p><a:pPr marL="342900" indent="-342900"><a:spcAft><a:spcPts val="400"/></a:spcAft><a:buSzPct val="100000"/><a:buChar char="&#x2022;"/></a:pPr><a:r><a:rPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"><a:solidFill><a:srgbClr val="2C3E50"/></a:solidFill><a:latin typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="0"/><a:ea typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-122"/><a:cs typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-120"/></a:rPr><a:t>Helmholtz Free Energy: A = U − TS. Relevant at constant volume. ΔA &lt; 0 for spontaneous isothermal process at constant V.</a:t></a:r><a:endParaRPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"/></a:p><a:p><a:pPr indent="0" marL="0"><a:buNone/></a:pPr><a:endParaRPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"/></a:p></p:txBody></p:sp><p:sp><p:nvSpPr><p:cNvPr id="5" name="Text 3"></p:cNvPr><p:cNvSpPr/><p:nvPr></p:nvPr></p:nvSpPr><p:spPr><a:xfrm><a:off x="274320" y="4663440"/><a:ext cx="8595360" cy="365760"/></a:xfrm><a:prstGeom prst="rect"><a:avLst></a:avLst></a:prstGeom><a:noFill/><a:ln></a:ln></p:spPr><p:txBody><a:bodyPr wrap="square" rtlCol="0" anchor="ctr"></a:bodyPr><a:lstStyle/><a:p><a:pPr indent="0" marL="0"><a:buNone/></a:pPr><a:r><a:rPr lang="en-US" sz="1000" i="1" dirty="0"><a:solidFill><a:srgbClr val="7F8C8D"/></a:solidFill><a:latin typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="0"/><a:ea typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-122"/><a:cs typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-120"/></a:rPr><a:t>Source: Atkins&apos; Physical Chemistry, 10th ed.; Callen, Thermodynamics and an Introduction to Thermostatistics</a:t></a:r><a:endParaRPr lang="en-US" sz="1000" dirty="0"/></a:p></p:txBody></p:sp></p:spTree></p:cSld><p:clrMapOvr><a:masterClrMapping/></p:clrMapOvr></p:sld>PK`

Decide one-tailed vs two-tailed test based on research question.</a:t></a:r><a:endParaRPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"/></a:p><a:p><a:pPr marL="342900" indent="-342900"><a:spcAft><a:spcPts val="400"/></a:spcAft><a:buSzPct val="100000"/><a:buChar char="&#x2022;"/></a:pPr><a:r><a:rPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"><a:solidFill><a:srgbClr val="2C3E50"/></a:solidFill><a:latin typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="0"/><a:ea typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-122"/><a:cs typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-120"/></a:rPr><a:t>Step 2 – Choose significance level α (commonly 0.05 or 0.01). This is the acceptable probability of a Type I error.</a:t></a:r><a:endParaRPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"/></a:p><a:p><a:pPr marL="342900" indent="-342900"><a:spcAft><a:spcPts val="400"/></a:spcAft><a:buSzPct val="100000"/><a:buChar char="&#x2022;"/></a:pPr><a:r><a:rPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"><a:solidFill><a:srgbClr val="2C3E50"/></a:solidFill><a:latin typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="0"/><a:ea typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-122"/><a:cs typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-120"/></a:rPr><a:t>Step 3 – Select test statistic: z = (x̄ − μ₀)/(σ/√n) for known σ; t = (x̄ − μ₀)/(s/√n) with df = n−1 for unknown σ.</a:t></a:r><a:endParaRPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"/></a:p><a:p><a:pPr marL="342900" indent="-342900"><a:spcAft><a:spcPts val="400"/></a:spcAft><a:buSzPct val="100000"/><a:buChar char="&#x2022;"/></a:pPr><a:r><a:rPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"><a:solidFill><a:srgbClr val="2C3E50"/></a:solidFill><a:latin typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="0"/><a:ea typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-122"/><a:cs typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-120"/></a:rPr><a:t>Step 4 – Compute p-value: P(observing result as or more extreme | H₀ true). Reject H₀ if p-value &lt; α.</a:t></a:r><a:endParaRPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"/></a:p><a:p><a:pPr marL="342900" indent="-342900"><a:spcAft><a:spcPts val="400"/></a:spcAft><a:buSzPct val="100000"/><a:buChar char="&#x2022;"/></a:pPr><a:r><a:rPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"><a:solidFill><a:srgbClr val="2C3E50"/></a:solidFill><a:latin typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="0"/><a:ea typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-122"/><a:cs typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-120"/></a:rPr><a:t>Step 5 – Effect size: Cohen&apos;s d = (x̄₁ − x̄₂)/s_pooled. Type II Error (β): Failing to reject a false H₀. Power = 1 − β.</a:t></a:r><a:endParaRPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"/></a:p><a:p><a:pPr marL="342900" indent="-342900"><a:spcAft><a:spcPts val="400"/></a:spcAft><a:buSzPct val="100000"/><a:buChar char="&#x2022;"/></a:pPr><a:r><a:rPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"><a:solidFill><a:srgbClr val="2C3E50"/></a:solidFill><a:latin typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="0"/><a:ea typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-122"/><a:cs typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-120"/></a:rPr><a:t>ANOVA F-statistic: F = MS_between / MS_within where MS = SS/df. Tests equality of means across ≥3 groups.</a:t></a:r><a:endParaRPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"/></a:p><a:p><a:pPr marL="342900" indent="-342900"><a:spcAft><a:spcPts val="400"/></a:spcAft><a:buSzPct val="100000"/><a:buChar char="&#x2022;"/></a:pPr><a:r><a:rPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"><a:solidFill><a:srgbClr val="2C3E50"/></a:solidFill><a:latin typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="0"/><a:ea typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-122"/><a:cs typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-120"/></a:rPr><a:t>Chi-square test: χ² = Σ(O−E)²/E. val="2C3E50"/></a:solidFill><a:latin typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="0"/><a:ea typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-122"/><a:cs typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-120"/></a:rPr><a:t>Axioms of a vector space V over field F: (1) Closure under + and scalar mult. (2) Commutativity and associativity of +. (3) Additive identity 0. (4) Additive inverse. Any two bases of V have the same cardinality.</a:t></a:r><a:endParaRPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"/></a:p><a:p><a:pPr marL="342900" indent="-342900"><a:spcAft><a:spcPts val="400"/></a:spcAft><a:buSzPct val="100000"/><a:buChar char="&#x2022;"/></a:pPr><a:r><a:rPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"><a:solidFill><a:srgbClr val="2C3E50"/></a:solidFill><a:latin typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="0"/><a:ea typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-122"/><a:cs typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-120"/></a:rPr><a:t>Rank-Nullity Theorem: rank(A) + nullity(A) = n  (for m×n matrix A). rank = dim(column space), nullity = dim(null space).</a:t></a:r><a:endParaRPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"/></a:p><a:p><a:pPr marL="342900" indent="-342900"><a:spcAft><a:spcPts val="400"/></a:spcAft><a:buSzPct val="100000"/><a:buChar char="&#x2022;"/></a:pPr><a:r><a:rPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"><a:solidFill><a:srgbClr val="2C3E50"/></a:solidFill><a:latin typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="0"/><a:ea typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-122"/><a:cs typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-120"/></a:rPr><a:t>Inner Product Space: ⟨u,v⟩ must be: linear in first arg, conjugate-symmetric, positive definite. For ℝⁿ: ⟨u,v⟩ = uᵀv.</a:t></a:r><a:endParaRPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"/></a:p><a:p><a:pPr marL="342900" indent="-342900"><a:spcAft><a:spcPts val="400"/></a:spcAft><a:buSzPct val="100000"/><a:buChar char="&#x2022;"/></a:pPr><a:r><a:rPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"><a:solidFill><a:srgbClr val="2C3E50"/></a:solidFill><a:latin typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="0"/><a:ea typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-122"/><a:cs typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-120"/></a:rPr><a:t>Cauchy–Schwarz Inequality: |⟨u,v⟩| ≤ ‖u‖·‖v‖. Equality iff u = λv.</a:t></a:r><a:endParaRPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"/></a:p><a:p><a:pPr marL="342900" indent="-342900"><a:spcAft><a:spcPts val="400"/></a:spcAft><a:buSzPct val="100000"/><a:buChar char="&#x2022;"/></a:pPr><a:r><a:rPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"><a:solidFill><a:srgbClr val="2C3E50"/></a:solidFill><a:latin typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="0"/><a:ea typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-122"/><a:cs typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-120"/></a:rPr><a:t>Gram-Schmidt Process: Converts any basis {v₁,…,vₙ} to orthonormal basis {e₁,…,eₙ} via projection subtraction.</a:t></a:r><a:endParaRPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"/></a:p><a:p><a:pPr marL="342900" indent="-342900"><a:spcAft><a:spcPts val="400"/></a:spcAft><a:buSzPct val="100000"/><a:buChar char="&#x2022;"/></a:pPr><a:r><a:rPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"><a:solidFill><a:srgbClr val="2C3E50"/></a:solidFill><a:latin typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="0"/><a:ea typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-122"/><a:cs typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-120"/></a:rPr><a:t>Projection onto subspace W: P = A(AᵀA)⁻¹Aᵀ  (columns of A span W). P² = P and Pᵀ = P (idempotent, symmetric).</a:t></a:r><a:endParaRPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"/></a:p><a:p><a:pPr marL="342900" indent="-342900"><a:spcAft><a:spcPts val="400"/></a:spcAft><a:buSzPct val="100000"/><a:buChar char="&#x2022;"/></a:pPr><a:r><a:rPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"><a:solidFill><a:srgbClr val="2C3E50"/></a:solidFill><a:latin typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="0"/><a:ea typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-122"/><a:cs typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-120"/></a:rPr><a:t>Spectral Decomposition (symmetric A): A = Σλᵢeᵢeᵢᵀ  (sum over eigenvalues; eᵢ are orthonormal eigenvectors).</a:t></a:r><a:endParaRPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"/></a:p><a:p><a:pPr indent="0" marL="0"><a:buNone/></a:pPr><a:endParaRPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"/></a:p></p:txBody></p:sp><p:sp><p:nvSpPr><p:cNvPr id="5" name="Text 3"></p:cNvPr><p:cNvSpPr/><p:nvPr></p:nvPr></p:nvSpPr><p:spPr><a:xfrm><a:off x="274320" y="4663440"/><a:ext cx="8595360" cy="365760"/></a:xfrm><a:prstGeom prst="rect"><a:avLst></a:avLst></a:prstGeom><a:noFill/><a:ln></a:ln></p:spPr><p:txBody><a:bodyPr wrap="square" rtlCol="0" anchor="ctr"></a:bodyPr><a:lstStyle/><a:p><a:pPr indent="0" marL="0"><a:buNone/></a:pPr><a:r><a:rPr lang="en-US" sz="1000" i="1" dirty="0"><a:solidFill><a:srgbClr val="7F8C8D"/></a:solidFill><a:latin typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="0"/><a:ea typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-122"/><a:cs typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-120"/></a:rPr><a:t>Source: Axler, Linear Algebra Done Right, 3rd ed.; Strang, Introduction to Linear Algebra, 5th ed.</a:t></a:r><a:endParaRPr lang="en-US" sz="1000" dirty="0"/></a:p></p:txBody></p:sp></p:spTree></p:cSld><p:clrMapOvr><a:masterClrMapping/></p:clrMapOvr></p:sld>PK`

Security Properties</a:t></a:r><a:endParaRPr lang="en-US" sz="2000" dirty="0"/></a:p></p:txBody></p:sp><p:sp><p:nvSpPr><p:cNvPr id="4" name="Text 2"></p:cNvPr><p:cNvSpPr/><p:nvPr></p:nvPr></p:nvSpPr><p:spPr><a:xfrm><a:off x="365760" y="777240"/><a:ext cx="8412480" cy="4023360"/></a:xfrm><a:prstGeom prst="rect"><a:avLst></a:avLst></a:prstGeom><a:noFill/><a:ln></a:ln></p:spPr><p:txBody><a:bodyPr wrap="square" rtlCol="0" anchor="ctr"></a:bodyPr><a:lstStyle/><a:p><a:pPr marL="342900" indent="-342900"><a:spcAft><a:spcPts val="400"/></a:spcAft><a:buSzPct val="100000"/><a:buChar char="&#x2022;"/></a:pPr><a:r><a:rPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"><a:solidFill><a:srgbClr val="2C3E50"/></a:solidFill><a:latin typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="0"/><a:ea typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-122"/><a:cs typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-120"/></a:rPr><a:t>RSA (1977): Security based on integer factorization hardness. Key generation: choose primes p,q; n=pq; φ(n)=(p−1)(q−1); e coprime to φ(n); d=e⁻¹ mod φ(n). Encrypt: C = Mᵉ mod n. Decrypt: M = Cᵈ mod n. Recommended minimum 2048-bit keys (3072-bit for 2030+).</a:t></a:r><a:endParaRPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"/></a:p><a:p><a:pPr marL="342900" indent="-342900"><a:spcAft><a:spcPts val="400"/></a:spcAft><a:buSzPct val="100000"/><a:buChar char="&#x2022;"/></a:pPr><a:r><a:rPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"><a:solidFill><a:srgbClr val="2C3E50"/></a:solidFill><a:latin typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="0"/><a:ea typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-122"/><a:cs typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-120"/></a:rPr><a:t>Elliptic Curve Diffie-Hellman (ECDH): Points on curve E: y²=x³+ax+b over finite field F_p. Key exchange: Shared secret = k_A · k_B · G (where G is generator point). NIST P-256 provides ~128-bit security with 256-bit keys vs RSA&apos;s 3072 bits.</a:t></a:r><a:endParaRPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"/></a:p><a:p><a:pPr marL="342900" indent="-342900"><a:spcAft><a:spcPts val="400"/></a:spcAft><a:buSzPct val="100000"/><a:buChar char="&#x2022;"/></a:pPr><a:r><a:rPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"><a:solidFill><a:srgbClr val="2C3E50"/></a:solidFill><a:latin typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="0"/><a:ea typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-122"/><a:cs typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-120"/></a:rPr><a:t>AES (Advanced Encryption Standard): 128/192/256-bit symmetric block cipher. 10/12/14 rounds. SubBytes, ShiftRows, MixColumns, AddRoundKey operations. AES-256-GCM provides authenticated encryption (AEAD) — confidentiality + integrity simultaneously.</a:t></a:r><a:endParaRPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"/></a:p><a:p><a:pPr marL="342900" indent="-342900"><a:spcAft><a:spcPts val="400"/></a:spcAft><a:buSzPct val="100000"/><a:buChar char="&#x2022;"/></a:pPr><a:r><a:rPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"><a:solidFill><a:srgbClr val="2C3E50"/></a:solidFill><a:latin typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="0"/><a:ea typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-122"/><a:cs typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-120"/></a:rPr><a:t>SHA-3 (Keccak): Sponge construction with rate r and capacity c. Output length 224/256/384/512 bits. Pre-image resistance: 2^n, collision resistance: 2^(n/2). Unlike SHA-2, structurally unrelated — provides diversity against structural attacks.</a:t></a:r><a:endParaRPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"/></a:p><a:p><a:pPr marL="342900" indent="-342900"><a:spcAft><a:spcPts val="400"/></a:spcAft><a:buSzPct val="100000"/><a:buChar char="&#x2022;"/></a:pPr><a:r><a:rPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"><a:solidFill><a:srgbClr val="2C3E50"/></a:solidFill><a:latin typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="0"/><a:ea typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-122"/><a:cs typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-120"/></a:rPr><a:t>Zero-Knowledge Proofs: Prover convinces verifier of statement truth without revealing why. Three properties: Completeness (true statements accepted), Soundness (false rejected), Zero-Knowledge (no info leaked). zk-SNARKs: succinct non-interactive ZKP — used in Zcash, Ethereum L2 rollups.</a:t></a:r><a:endParaRPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"/></a:p><a:p><a:pPr marL="342900" indent="-342900"><a:spcAft><a:spcPts val="400"/></a:spcAft><a:buSzPct val="100000"/><a:buChar char="&#x2022;"/></a:pPr><a:r><a:rPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"><a:solidFill><a:srgbClr val="2C3E50"/></a:solidFill><a:latin typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="0"/><a:ea typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-122"/><a:cs typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-120"/></a:rPr><a:t>Post-Quantum Cryptography (NIST Round 4): CRYSTALS-Kyber (key encapsulation, lattice), CRYSTALS-Dilithium (signatures, lattice), SPHINCS+ (signatures, hash-based). Classical RSA/ECC broken by Shor&apos;s algorithm on quantum computer with sufficient qubits.</a:t></a:r><a:endParaRPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"/></a:p><a:p><a:pPr indent="0" marL="0"><a:buNone/></a:pPr><a:endParaRPr lang="en-US" sz="1300" dirty="0"/></a:p></p:txBody></p:sp><p:sp><p:nvSpPr><p:cNvPr id="5" name="Text 3"></p:cNvPr><p:cNvSpPr/><p:nvPr></p:nvPr></p:nvSpPr><p:spPr><a:xfrm><a:off x="274320" y="4663440"/><a:ext cx="8595360" cy="365760"/></a:xfrm><a:prstGeom prst="rect"><a:avLst></a:avLst></a:prstGeom><a:noFill/><a:ln></a:ln></p:spPr><p:txBody><a:bodyPr wrap="square" rtlCol="0" anchor="ctr"></a:bodyPr><a:lstStyle/><a:p><a:pPr indent="0" marL="0"><a:buNone/></a:pPr><a:r><a:rPr lang="en-US" sz="1000" i="1" dirty="0"><a:solidFill><a:srgbClr val="7F8C8D"/></a:solidFill><a:latin typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="0"/><a:ea typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-122"/><a:cs typeface="Calibri" pitchFamily="34" charset="-120"/></a:rPr><a:t>Reference: NIST SP 800-131A Rev 2; Bernstein &amp; Lange (2017) Post-quantum cryptography. Nature.</a:t></a:r><a:endParaRPr lang="en-US" sz="1000" dirty="0"/></a:p></p:txBody></p:sp></p:spTree></p:cSld><p:clrMapOvr><a:masterClrMapping/></p:clrMapOvr></p:sld>PK`
